name: restassured-testng-api-dotstrap-automation-postman
description: Runs the Postman collection with Newman (CLI + HTML report).

scripts.newman:ci: newman run restassured-testng-api-Dotstrap-Automation.postman_collection.json -e environments/ci.postman_environment.json -r cli,htmlextra,junit --reporter-htmlextra-skipSensitiveData --reporter-htmlextra-export ../reports/newman/index.html --reporter-htmlextra-title "Reference service — Newman" --reporter-junit-export ../reports/newman/junit.xml
